title: Conditional GAN analysis linked cancer-stem-cell image morphology with marker status
summary: A conditional generative adversarial network segmented cancer-stem-cell morphology from phase-contrast images and predicted GFP/Nanog-associated status in a mouse-derived cell model. The result links visible morphology to stemness markers in this experimental setting.
ai_technology: Conditional generative adversarial network for cell-image segmentation and marker-status prediction.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: Phase-contrast images were analyzed against GFP/Nanog-associated cell labels in a mouse-derived cancer-stem-cell model.
evidence.unknown: Cell-model result only; no broader in-vivo validation or human clinical outcome established.
evidence.ai_role: Conditional generative adversarial network for cell-image segmentation and marker-status prediction.
